title: UPMC agrees to end gender-affirming care for minors under federal settlement
summary: UPMC agreed under a federal settlement announced Sept. 18, 2026 to stop providing pediatric gender-affirming care for minors at UPMC-affiliated facilities, including UPMC Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh. This release frames the development as a service-cessation and access-loss event for minors seeking that care, while noting that the settlement terms were not fully public in the Pennsylvania Capital-Star account and that UPMC said the agreement includes no admission of wrongdoing, fault, or liability.
